svg.title: Introducing Bespoke Nimble
svg.text: An open data, open model, open recipe for an open Jev
Read the prompt once, then one token per question
Prefill the shared prompt once (KV cache)
No text to parse. Median 106 ms per question on one H100.
Change one fact, and the correct answer flips
Only Mira may authorize refunds for account 42.
Extract a fact and flip one fact
Check that removing a fact makes the answer unknown
Keep pairs that pass every check
Fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B on the answer tokens only
The loss is cross-entropy over the allowed answer codes only.
Labels come from our checked data. We did not distill from Jev.
Agreement with reference labels on 324 held-out examples
